function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to help you find the perfect place to order a cake—whether it’s for a birthday, wedding, corporate event, or just a sweet treat for yourself.

---

## 1️⃣ Local Bakeries & Specialty Shops  
| What to Look For | Why It Matters | How to Order |
|------------------|----------------|--------------|
| **Reputation & Reviews** | A good rating often means consistent quality. | Google Maps, Yelp, Facebook |
| **Specialty Offerings** | Some bakeries specialize in vegan, gluten‑free, or custom designs. | Call or visit their website |
| **Delivery Options** | Many local shops now offer curbside pickup or direct delivery. | Ask about delivery fees/time |

### Popular Chains (U.S.)
- **Bakeri** – Known for artisanal cupcakes and custom cakes.  
- **The Sweet Spot** – Offers a wide range of flavors and décor styles.  
- **Cake Boss Bakery** – Great for large orders and themed cakes.

### International Options
- **Patisserie Boulud** (France) – Luxury French pastries delivered worldwide.  
- **Mitsuwa Marketplace** (Japan) – Japanese sweets and Western-style cakes.  

---

## 2️⃣ Online Delivery Platforms  
| Platform | Strengths | Typical Price Range* | How to Use |
|----------|-----------|----------------------|------------|
| **Uber Eats** | Huge selection of restaurants and bakeries. | $10–$50 per cake | Search “cake” + your city |
| **DoorDash** | Often includes discounts and promo codes. | $12–$55 per cake | Browse “Desserts” or “Bakery” |
| **Postmates** | Fast delivery, sometimes same‑day. | $15–$60 per cake | Filter by “Bakery” |
| **Instacart** | Grocery plus specialty items; great for bulk orders. | $20–$70 per cake | Add to cart, schedule delivery |
| **Amazon Fresh** | Reliable delivery windows, easy returns. | $18–$65 per cake | Search “custom cake” |

\*Prices vary by city, size, and customization level.

---

## 3️⃣ Dedicated Cake Delivery Services  
| Service | Highlights | When to Use |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| **Goldbelly** | Curated selection from top U.S. bakeries; nationwide shipping. | Special occasions, gifts |
| **Cake Delivery** | Same‑day delivery in select cities; offers “just in time” service. | Last‑minute orders |
| **BakeShop** | Custom design templates; easy online ordering. | Personalized cakes |
| **Etsy** | Handmade, artisanal cakes from independent bakers. | Unique, niche flavors |

---

## 4️⃣ Tips for Ordering the Right Cake

| Tip | Why It Helps |
|-----|--------------|
| **Specify Size & Shape** | Ensures the cake fits your venue or number of guests. |
| **Mention Dietary Restrictions Early** | Avoids last‑minute substitutions. |
| **Ask About Delivery Time Slots** | Guarantees freshness and timing for events. |
| **Check Cancellation Policies** | Some platforms charge a fee if you cancel late. |
| **Read Return/Refund Policies** | Useful if the cake arrives damaged or unsatisfactory. |

---

## 5️⃣ Sample Order Flow (Using Uber Eats)

1. **Open the app** → Search “cake” or “bakery.”  
2. **Filter results** → Choose “Custom Cakes” or “Birthday Cakes.”  
3. **Select a shop** → Read reviews, view menu.  
4. **Add to cart** → Specify flavor, size, and any custom text.  
5. **Choose delivery** → Pick a time slot (e.g., “Today at 7 pm”).  
6. **Pay** → Use credit card or PayPal.  
7. **Track** → Receive real‑time updates on the delivery status.

---

## 6️⃣ Quick List of Places to Check Out

| City | Suggested Place | Notes |
|------|-----------------|-------|
| New York | **Magnolia Bakery** | Classic American cakes, free delivery within Manhattan. |
| Los Angeles | **The Cake Shop** | Vegan options, same‑day delivery via Postmates. |
| Chicago | **Baker & Co.** | Custom wedding cakes, free pickup. |
| London | **The Sweet Life** | British‑style sponge cakes, free delivery within central London. |
| Tokyo | **Tokyo Cake House** | Japanese‑inspired flavors, free pickup. |

---

### Final Thought  
If you’re looking for something truly unique, consider ordering from a local artisan who can tailor the cake to your exact specifications. For convenience and speed, a platform like Uber Eats or DoorDash is usually the best bet. And don’t forget to double‑check the delivery window so your cake arrives fresh and on time!
